visualCharacteristics: Full-width hero slider with looping slides, prev/next arrows, bullets and neighbour click; slides stacked/scaled on desktop, sliding track on mobile. Default leaf-green colourway.
contentPattern: One row per slide: cell 1 images (mobile crop, desktop crop), cell 2 content (title, text, CTA). First titled slide carries the page h1.
usage: Home-page hero carousels on the global and locale home pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any multi-slide hero; use Page Lead for a single static intro.
name: Carousel
